episode_summary: In this episode, Kelsey Caputo discusses how AI can be leveraged to enhance real estate practices, particularly in the luxury market. She emphasizes the irreplaceable value of local knowledge and relationship-building, while also sharing insights on using AI to predict client objections and build targeted buyer profiles.
